subject: Saturday plan
text: Quick thing about Saturday. I know we said museum, but I might need to help my brother move shelves first, which is why I’m rambling. If that goes okay, could you meet me near the café instead of the entrance? Maybe eleven, unless you have that appointment? I brought the tickets, I think, under the laptop bag. Let me know if you prefer noon. Also I have my sister coming by later, so it might be rushed, but I would still like to see you. Sorry if this is messy.
